item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Taking it consistently matters more than taking it perfectly. Pick one fixed cue, like brushing your teeth or your morning meditation, and tie your dose to it. Notice if skipped doses come from forgetting, side effects, or doubt, because each needs a different fix. Never change a dose on your own. Bring those observations to your prescriber. Action: set one daily reminder for your medication right now.
